prompts.rear: Asset type: transparent rear layer of a two-layer Vietnamese classroom cartoon ferry. Image 1 is the exact boat silhouette/material reference; image 2 shows the schoolchildren and teacher it must fit. Generate ONLY the REAR/INTERIOR layer, no people. Keep a very wide 3:1 canvas. Match the reference's warm reddish-brown wooden planks, dark clean cartoon outlines and subtle shading. Entire boat from stern at left to bow at right, shallow curved hull, NO roof. The distant gunwale/back wall, visible inner floor, 6 low transverse benches and both upturned ends belong in this rear layer. CRITICAL: the entire near-facing outer side/hull/gunwale must be OMITTED, leaving an OPEN FRONT so characters drawn on top can later be occluded by a separate front layer. This is a theatrical cutaway of an open boat, not a complete enclosed boat. Keep both ends at approximately x=2% and 98%, upper end tips y=20%, back rail center y=40%, interior floor center bottom y=78%, empty transparent space elsewhere. Floor and bench perspective is shallow, with room for three rows of small seated children between x=30% and 89%; teacher at x=10%. Full boat silhouette same scale and horizontal registration as reference, generous transparent space above. Transparent alpha background. No water, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no white background, no front hull. Production-ready game sprite.
prompts.front: Create ONLY the FRONT EXTERIOR HULL overlay for the exact Vietnamese cartoon ferry in image 1. No cast shadow, no water, no text, no thick rectangular block, no second boat, no background. Full canvas should register with the rear sprite without trimming.
